question.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 4 & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$

 

Consider the matrix $A$ and vector $b$ above. If the normal equation corresponding to the system $Ax=b$ is given below, what is the value of $a-b-c?$ 

$$
[\begin{aligned}18 & 1 & 36 \\ 1 & 2 & 2 \\ b & 2 & a\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 2 \\ c\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
The normal equation corresponding to $Ax=b$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{T}\,Ax & ={A}^{T}b \\ [\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 8 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 4 & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 8 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}18 & 1 & 36 \\ 1 & 2 & 2 \\ 36 & 2 & 72\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 2 \\ 20\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a=72,\,b=36,\,c=20,
$$

and hence

$$
a-b-c=72-36-20=16.
$$
